fields.FIR_Description: A oral complaint dated 2025-08-26 states that the complainant paid Rs. 3,50,000 as a processing fee for a promised loan that was never disbursed, on 2025-08-25 around 12:00 hrs. The complaint was lodged by Kishore Pandian (9000000200). Nithin Velan (9000000004) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. The complainant alleged that Mathan Velan may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000147. Items referenced in the complaint: physical documents.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Agent reportedly claimed a guaranteed approval and became unreachable.
fields.Keywords: loan fraud, processing fee, witness, suspect, afternoon, documents, mobile number, residential colony
